verdict.rationale: Kong's ecosystem (via Insomnia) does ship built-in AI features you can delegate discrete tasks to — AI-assisted mock server generation from natural-language prompts, AI commit message suggestions, and an LLM toggle in Preferences — which count as a built-in assistant, but this is narrow and Insomnia-specific rather than a general-purpose in-product agent across Kong Gateway/Konnect. Missing for 10: evidence of a general conversational/task-delegation assistant embedded in Kong Gateway or Konnect itself (not just Insomnia's design-time AI helpers), and independent hands-on validation of these AI features' reliability.
